title: Zod #5371: TypeError when creating self-referencing lazy schemas

error_signal.message: zod TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined in $ZodLazy innerType when creating a self-referencing lazy schema with z.lazy

ground_truth.root_cause_description: Missing optional chaining for innerType in $ZodLazy. When a lazy schema self-references, innerType is undefined during initial construction.
ground_truth.fix_description: Add optional chaining for innerType access in $ZodLazy
